name: qvc-biblioteca-educacional
description: Biblioteca de ferramentas pedagógicas em HTML5, JavaScript moderno e Tailwind CSS

scripts.build: npm run build:css && node scripts/offline.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs Biblioteca/Calculos/tests/*.test.mjs "Biblioteca/Gera Provas"/*.test.mjs Biblioteca/HorarioEscolar/*.test.mjs Biblioteca/Atividades/*.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write scripts tests styles Biblioteca/shared Biblioteca/index.html README.md package.json index.html
